```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
Center_volume_raw <- read_excel("Center volume_v.xls", 
     sheet = "Data")

Center_volume_clean<-Center_volume_raw%>%
  mutate(REGION=as.factor(REGION))


waitlist_times_raw <- read_excel("waitlist_times_v.xlsx", 
    sheet = "data")

waitlist_times_clean<-waitlist_times_raw%>%
  mutate(dcd=case_when(
    dcd==0~"DBD-HK",
    dcd==1~"DCD-HK",
    dcd==2~"DCD-HK after"))%>%
    mutate(dcd=as.factor(dcd))%>%
  mutate(rec_abo_o=case_when(
    rec_abo_o==0~"Non-O Blood Group",
    rec_abo_o==1~"Blood Group O"))%>%
    mutate(rec_abo_o=as.factor(rec_abo_o))

```


```{r}

Center_volume_clean%>%ggplot()+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=Freq_total, y=Freq_dcd, color=REGION))+
  geom_text_repel(mapping=aes(x=Freq_total, y=Freq_dcd, label=REGION),
                  max.overlaps = Inf)+
  labs(x="Center volume (Total multiorgan HTs at a center)",
       y="Multiorgan HTs with DCD donors")+
  ylim(-2, 20)+
  theme_bw()
  ggsave("DCD Figure 2.png")
  

```

```{r}

my_comparisons <- list( c("DBD-HK", "DCD-HK"), 
                        c("DBD-HK", "DCD-HK after recipient agreed to DCD-donor"))

waitlist_times_clean%>%ggplot(mapping = aes(x=dcd, y=total_wait_dcd_month))+
  geom_violin(color = NA, alpha=0.5,fill = "grey", 
              draw_quantiles = 1)+
  ylim(0,20)+ 
  geom_quasirandom(mapping = aes(x=dcd, y=total_wait_dcd_month, color=dcd), 
                   cex=2, alpha=0.7)+
  stat_summary(fun = median, fun.min = median, 
               fun.max = median, 
               geom = "crossbar", width = 0.9, fatten=1.5)+
  #stat_summary(mapping = aes(x=dcd, y=total_wait_dcd_month),fun = median, 
   #            fun.min = median, fun.max = median,

  labs(x = "", y="Wait list time")+

ggsave("Figure 4A.png")
```
